text:
maya: Quick weekend poll — who’s up for a plant-swap at Bluebird Cafe (10am) vs rooftop jazz picnic (6pm)? Or both if you're crazy? :seedling: :saxophone:

sam: Plant-swap for me. need more succulents in my life. :seedling:

leo: Rooftop jazz! I can bring a portable speaker + my ukulele. :guitar:

olivia: Can we do both? plant-swap 10am, nap, rooftop 6pm. Perfect lazy marathon. :zzz:

jamie: Late works better for me. rooftop sounds great. also, weather check — Sat might have showers?

maya: Good call — if it rains we can move jazz to Sunday or inside the lounge. Opinions?

sam: If it rains i'll host the plant swap in my tiny kitchen and we’ll pretend it’s cozy. :grimacing:

leo: @jamie meteor says ~40% chance Sat evening. We have that canopy in storage — that could save the rooftop.

olivia: Can someone bring labels/Sharpies? Also please tag plants with light needs (low/med/high).

maya: I’ll make a tiny checklist:
```
- label + marker
- extra 2" pots
- small bag of potting mix
- swap table + tray
- snacks + water
```

jamie: I’ll bring extra pots and a box of fairy lights — they’d look cute on the railing. :sparkles:

calendar-bot: Event created: "Plant Swap + Rooftop Jazz" — Sat 10:00 AM & 6:00 PM — RSVP open https://calendar.company/events/12345

sam: RSVP'd. also bringing a mystery plant for dramatic effect. :face_with_monocle:

leo: GIF: https://giphy.com/ukulele-happy.gif :laughing:

olivia: Anyone driving from SoMa? I have 2 seats if people want to carpool.

maya: @olivia yes please! leaving lobby 9:15 for Bluebird.

jamie: Heads up — please only bring non-invasive plants and note if a plant is pet-toxic.

sam: noted. labeling will be dramatic and thorough. :label:

maya: Sweet. See y'all this weekend :party_parrot:
